artifact_bounds.legacy_others: No explicit aggregate upload byte cap in examples, Claude, Core smoke, portable, rmcp, strict-pair, parser gates. Existing finite authored suites and job timeouts retained; no universal artifact-size guarantee.

dependency_policy.pins: Each standalone package preserves exact accepted manifest/lock. Core3f, Core1fc and official Modules7f/SDKbee0 graphs remain separate. No Cargo resolver/lock regeneration. Current-Core uses hostSDK1fc plus unchanged process moduleSDK3f.

excluded: No private local notes, auth transcripts, raw newly downloaded artifacts, failed intermediate trees or obsolete active lock-only workflows are added. Inert historical lock helpers/manifests already frozen within accepted final package trees remain unchanged and are not scheduled.
limitations: Package coexistence, not automatic coactivation or productionrelease.
Hermesv1 and strictv2 both export hermes.verify_evidence; choose only one per runtime profile.
No source edits to Proteus Core or official Modules.
Historical reports and manifests retain their snapshot semantics, including older pending wording.
No merge, auto-merge, ready conversion or deployment.
This manifest identifies composition, not future aggregate CI success.
